name: The Fury: The Sovereign of Rage and Ruin

description.value:
The Fury is the sovereign of primal passion, righteous wrath, and untamed instinct. Feared in the Five Nations as senseless madness, in Droaam and the frontier she is revered as the patron of survival—the mother defending her young, the fire that breaks chains, and the refusal to submit to oppressors.
Areas of Concern Anger, primal passion, survival, revenge, extremism
Alignment NE
Divine Font Harm
Divine Ability Strength or Dexterity
Divine Skill Intimidation
Domains Ambition, Delirium, Destruction, Freedom, Might, Pain, Passion, Zeal
Cleric Spells 1st: sure strike, 3rd: fireball, 4th: translocate
Edicts Refuse to submit to tyrants or oppressors, fight fiercely to protect your kin and freedom, claim what you desire, strike back with righteous fury.
Anathema Allow an insult or injustice against you or your kin to go unanswered, show weakness or fear before an enemy, submit quietly to bondage.
Favoured Weapon Rapier
